product_metadata.title: Furinno Gruen 3-Tier Bookcases, Blackwood
features: Manufactured from high quality composite wood to ensure added durability and stability.
Comes in multiple color options for easy customization.
Adjustable shelf feature to fit your needs.
Each shelf has a weight capacity of 15 pounds. Bottom shelf can hold up to 25 lbs.
description: A sleek and sturdy 3-shelf bookcase with multiple color options that adds functional and stylish look to any room setting. Made from quality particle board, Gruen has a closed-back design with adjustable shelves that holds up to 15 lbs per shelf and 25 lbs for bottom shelf. Assembly is easy with clear step by step assembly instructions and hardware pack provided. This attractive bookshelf provides ample storage space and fits well in most rooms. Care instructions: wipe clean with clean damped cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purpose. All decor items are not included in this offer.
